ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Na pivo uses your location to find pubs nearby and point the arrow. Your current or approximate location may be sent to our server; we never store a GPS trail or location history.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: In the evening, Na pivo can occasionally check whether you are sitting at a pub and remind you to pick the pub and count your beers, even when the app is closed or not in use. We never store a GPS trail or location history.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: We use the motion sensors to turn the arrow when you turn.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The microphone is used only for the app's sound features and never without your consent.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: I open your gallery so you can pick a profile photo, a photo of the beer menu, or a beer photo for your diary.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: I save a sticker to your Photos when you ask. This doesn't let me see your other photos.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: I need the camera to read beers off a menu and to let you snap a beer for your diary.
ios.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Na pivo only adds a crew invitation to your calendar after you confirm it.
ios.NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescripti: Na pivo only adds a crew invitation to your calendar after you confirm it.
ios.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Na pivo does not use reminders.
ios.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: Na pivo does not use reminders.
